text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Training ahead of the Kyodo News Hai. 
Duramente kept running as though wringing out 
every last drop of strength to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
It comes from her fixation on pulling clear. 
But running that way puts a heavy load on her body.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
So for the Kyodo News Hai, I set her the task 
of running while keeping herself calm.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente seemed aware herself that her feelings 
run away with her once a race starts. 
She accepted the task and went to the race.
